approval.basis: User explicitly requested breakdown and GitHub upload of remaining female day running editorials.

copy.captionKo: 코랄과 버건디, 올리브로 마무리하는 한 걸음.
copy.captionEn: Coral over burgundy, finished in olive.
copy.captionDe: Koralle über Burgunder, abgerundet mit Oliv.
copy.introKo: 코랄 셸과 버건디 이너를 겹쳐 따뜻한 색의 깊이를 만들어요. 긴 커프를 소매 밖으로 드러내고, 슬레이트 타이츠와 아이보리 삭스 사이에 올리브 러너를 더해요.
copy.introEn: Layer coral over burgundy for depth within a warm palette. Let the long cuffs extend past the shell sleeves, then add slate tights, ivory socks and olive runners.
copy.introDe: Schichte Koralle über Burgunder für Tiefe in einer warmen Farbpalette. Lasse die langen Bündchen unter der Jacke hervorschauen und ergänze schiefergraue Tights, elfenbeinfarbene Socken und olivgrüne Laufschuhe.

products.descriptionKo: 코랄 셸을 주인공으로 두고 앞을 살짝 열어요. 안쪽 버건디가 밝은 색에 깊이를 더해요.
products.descriptionEn: Make coral the focal point and open the shell slightly to show the deeper burgundy beneath.
products.descriptionDe: Setze Koralle in den Mittelpunkt und öffne die Jacke leicht, um das tiefere Burgunder darunter zu zeigen.
products.altKo: 코랄 러닝 셸 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: coral red-orange hooded lightweight running windbreaker, full front zip, elastic cuffs, silver reflective narrow strips at upper front and lower side pockets

products.descriptionKo: 버건디 롱슬리브의 긴 커프를 손등까지 이어줘요. 별도 장갑 대신 소매 디테일을 보여주는 조합이에요.
products.descriptionEn: Extend the burgundy thumbhole cuffs over the backs of the hands; these are shirt cuffs, not separate gloves.
products.descriptionDe: Ziehe die langen burgunderfarbenen Daumenlochbündchen über die Handrücken; sie gehören zum Shirt und sind keine separaten Handschuhe.
products.altKo: 버건디 커프 롱슬리브 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: burgundy plum crewneck long-sleeve running base layer with elongated thumbhole cuffs covering backs of hands, thin silver accents on cuff backs; these cuffs belong to shirt, not separate gloves; hidden torso reconstructed simply

products.descriptionKo: 슬레이트 타이츠로 코랄과 버건디의 채도를 받쳐요. 밝은 양말이 보이도록 밑단을 정리해요.
products.descriptionEn: Let slate tights balance coral and burgundy, keeping the hems neat above the pale socks.
products.descriptionDe: Schiefergraue Tights gleichen Koralle und Burgunder aus; ordne die Säume oberhalb der hellen Socken.
products.altKo: 슬레이트 러닝 타이츠 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: full-length slate charcoal-grey fitted running tights, visible seam panels at thighs, narrow silver reflective shin strips; waistband concealed, reconstruct conservatively

products.descriptionKo: 아이보리 리브 삭스를 발목 위로 드러내요. 올리브 슈즈와 타이츠 사이에 밝은 간격을 만들어요.
products.descriptionEn: Show ivory rib socks above the ankle for a pale break between slate tights and olive shoes.
products.descriptionDe: Lasse elfenbeinfarbene Rippensocken über dem Knöchel sichtbar, als helle Unterbrechung zwischen Tights und olivgrünen Schuhen.
products.altKo: 아이보리 리브 삭스 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: matching pair ivory/off-white chunky ribbed short crew socks, match reference ribbing and cuff height

products.descriptionKo: 올리브 러너로 따뜻한 상의 색을 차분하게 마무리해요. 크림 솔을 양말과 연결해요.
products.descriptionEn: Olive runners settle the warm upper layers, with cream soles echoing the socks.
products.descriptionDe: Olivgrüne Laufschuhe beruhigen die warmen Oberteile; die cremefarbene Sohle greift die Socken auf.
products.altKo: 올리브 메쉬 러너 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: matching pair muted olive green mesh lace-up running sneakers, tonal darker side support overlays, olive laces, thick off-white foam soles with black outsole toe edges

reconstructionNotes: Hidden backs, waistbands, inside construction and opposite shoes are conservative reconstructions, not verified product specifications.
Exact temperature and feels-like temperature are unknown; Chilly is grounded in the source folder.
Burgundy hand coverings interpreted as extended thumbhole shirt cuffs, not separate gloves; this construction is inferred from the reference.
